== Summary ==
Decipher / Parker Brothers, [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet (February 1996). Byte-identical copy of Hasbro's scanned instruction PDF (scanned 17 July 2001): [https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Internet Archive]

Used on [[Rulebooks]].
